narrative.overview: A comfortable notebook carried through mountains, forest, coast and fields: moss-green cover on the left, a pale paper page on the right, thick green rules marking each entry. The tone is practical, gentle and organised, with flat surfaces and ruled lines instead of boxes and shadows.
keyCharacteristics: A fixed moss-green sidebar (the cover) beside a pale-grey page (the paper).
Flat and shadowless; structure comes from thick green rules, left borders and tonal blocks.
A single natural green family used for rules, accents and identity.
Sora for headings and labels, Open Sans for reading text.
Numbers and domain labels are the visual focal points, not ornaments.

rules.name: The Green Family Rule
rules.body: Only the two greens express identity. Do not introduce a third accent hue.

rules.name: The Rule Line Rule
rules.body: Section structure is drawn with Sage Rule lines, not boxes, fills or shadows.

rules.name: The Root-10 Rule
rules.body: The root is 62.5% so 1rem equals 10px by default; always specify sizes in rem.

rules.name: The Quiet Quote Rule
rules.body: Montserrat italic appears only in the sidebar quote.

rules.name: The Flat-On-Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift; hover is a color change, a nudge or opacity, never a shadow.

dos: Do build hierarchy with Sage Rule lines and tonal blocks (Card White on Page Paper).
Do keep one green family: Moss Ledger for identity and fills, Sage Rule for lines.
Do use rem units against the 62.5% root, and keep reading text at or above 1.75rem.
Do lead with the number or outcome when presenting a result, followed by its domain label.
Do keep a visible focus ring (Deep Tide, or white in the sidebar) on every interactive element.
Do mark Chinese text with lang="zh-Hant".
donts: Don't add box-shadows, glows or lifted cards.
Don't introduce a third accent hue or gradients.
Don't put Sage Rule (#7d9a64) behind white text or as small text on Page Paper; it is a line color, not a text color.
Don't use Montserrat italic outside the sidebar quote.
Don't round cards or sections; only small controls and tags are rounded.
Don't add decorative imagery or icons that do not carry information.
